cause: Collaboration attachment authority required a linked client. Commercial businesses can be in cotizando/propuesta before emission creates a canonical client, so a real handoff could fail even though the synthetic fixture had clienteId.
correction: Negocio document authority now supports a pre-emission business with no clientId, binds documents to the business, and uses a dedicated _NEGOCIOS Drive folder (and Preview negocios folder). Existing linked-client behavior remains supported.
